retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, desaturated urban scene featuring a central figure in a reflective puffer jacket standing before a luxury vehicle in heavy rain.

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, desaturated composition centered on a man in a shiny black puffer jacket leaning against a dark SUV. The scene is set at night under heavy rain, with dramatic lighting from car headlights creating strong highlights on the wet ground and the subject's clothing.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a dark vehicle backdrop
High-contrast lighting between dark shadows and bright rain highlights
Tall, condensed typography balanced against the verticality of the subject
Textural contrast between the smooth car surface and the crinkled puffer jacket
coreInvariants: Desaturated, near-monochrome color palette with cool blue undertones
Reflective highlights on the subject's outerwear

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The reflective highlights on the puffer jacket and the bright car headlights.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the reflective jacket, then right to the large vertical typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper corners and lower foreground provide breathing room for the rain texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool white and silver (rain, highlights, and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between deep blacks and bright whites.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and hairline horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightened letter spacing to emphasize verticality
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the tall display serif with a small, blocky sans-serif for metadata or secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme condensed verticality and serif style.
Provides the necessary high-contrast Didone look in a condensed width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a night scene of a man in a shiny black puffer jacket standing in front of a dark SUV on a wet city street during a heavy rainstorm. Use high contrast and a desaturated color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically condensed serif text in white on the right side of the frame, stacked vertically.

verificationChecks: Is the rain texture visible across the entire frame?
Is the text vertically elongated and high-contrast?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated/cool?
Does the jacket have realistic specular highlights?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast highlights on the puffer jacket.
Ensure the text is perfectly vertical and right-aligned.
Verify the rain streaks are predominantly vertical.
Confirm the absence of vibrant colors.
